headline: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator’s writers with ChatGPT
summary: Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch denies claims of replacing game writers with AI for 'Rideshare Stimulator'. Former lead writer Stella Sacco asserts she was replaced by ChatGPT. The controversy surrounds the game developed by Unigine.

headline: Xbox Elite 3 prototype pad leaks with tiny built-in screen
summary: A Redditor reportedly bought a prototype Xbox Elite Series 3 controller for $200. The leaked pad features a distinctive tiny built-in screen. Previous leaks from a Brazilian regulator in May hinted at new Xbox hardware.

headline: An FCC filing points to new Sonos headphones coming soon
summary: An FCC filing by Sonos, Inc. reveals details about upcoming wireless headphones (model S52A). This hints at a successor to the Sonos Ace headphones, possibly arriving this fall. Sonos CEO Tom Conrad previously hinted at new hardware during an earnings call.

headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: Google's Gemini AI has reached 1 billion monthly users, marking its fastest growth ever. OpenAI's ChatGPT also recently surpassed the 1 billion user milestone. This highlights a significant user adoption for leading AI applications.

headline: Sony Announces Phantom Blade Zero State of Play and Everyone Knows How the Chat Is Going to Go
summary: Sony announced a dedicated State of Play event for the action game Phantom Blade Zero. Anticipation suggests the event's chat will be flooded with criticism. Fans are expected to voice anger over Sony's decision to discontinue PlayStation discs.

headline: What Does X-Men '97 Season 2's Post-Credits Scene Mean for Season 3?
summary: This article analyzes the post-credits scene from the X-Men '97 Season 2 finale. It aims to explain the implications for the upcoming Season 3. The scene sets up future plot developments for the animated series.

headline: X-Men '97 Season 2 Finale Review & Recap: "Survival of the Fittest"
summary: The X-Men '97 Season 2 finale, 'Survival of the Fittest,' receives a critical review. The episode is criticized for its relentless pacing. The final battle with Apocalypse is described as failing to impress.

headline: Zack Snyder Returns to Warner Bros. Lot Years After DCEU Exit
summary: Filmmaker Zack Snyder made a surprising return to the Warner Bros. studio lot. This visit comes years after his contentious exit from the DCEU. The appearance has sparked widespread speculation about his future projects with the studio.

headline: Three ways to watch the solar eclipse safely without glasses
summary: Many shops are out of stock for solar eclipse glasses ahead of the event. The article provides three safe methods to view the eclipse without special eyewear. These methods utilize common household items for projection.

headline: Early release scheme risks more serious crimes, probation chief warns
summary: England and Wales' chief inspector of probation warns of risks from an early release scheme. He states the scheme could lead to an increase in serious crimes. Probation services are already facing 'unprecedented pressure'.

headline: Woman assaulted by double murderer says nightmare became 'real life' when police let him attack again
summary: A woman describes her ordeal after being assaulted by serial sex offender Simon Levy. Levy went on to murder two women and rape another due to police errors. The victim highlights the devastating consequences of disastrous decisions that left Levy free.

headline: Burnham to chair Cobra meeting on extreme heat as temperatures surge again
summary: The UK government will hold a Cobra meeting to address record-breaking summer heat. Temperatures continue to surge, exceeding 30C for multiple days. Andy Burnham is set to chair the emergency meeting.
